title: DataFlex-RL: An Evaluation Platform for RLVR Data Policies
abstract: arXiv:2609.06107v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Data policies for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) determine which rollouts are used, how strongly they are weighted, and which domains contribute to subsequent training batches. We introduce DataFlex-RL, an evaluation platform for comparing these choices under a common GRPO recipe. Our primary experiment evaluates 13 configurations across 12 matched seeds using Qwen2.5-7B-Base and 12 mathematics, logic, and science benchmarks. Uniform GRPO improves the domain-balanced average accuracy by 7.76 percentage points over the untrained checkpoint. None of the eight rollout-selection or reweighting methods achieves a paired 95% confidence interval that excludes zero relative to uniform sampling, and none of the three adaptive mixtures outperforms a fixed equal mixture at the same level of precision. translated_abstract: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的数据策略决定了使用哪些rollout、它们的加权强度，以及哪些领域为后续训练批次做出贡献。我们提出了DataFlex-RL，这是一个在统一GRPO配方下比较这些选择的评估平台。我们的主要实验使用Qwen2.5-7B-Base模型和12个数学、逻辑和科学基准测试，在12个匹配的随机种子上评估了13种配置。均匀GRPO相比未训练的检查点将领域平衡平均准确率提高了7.76个百分点。八种rollout选择或重新加权方法中，没有一种相对于均匀采样达到排除零的配对95%置信区间；三种自适应混合方法中，也没有一种在相同精度水平下优于固定的等比例混合。在Llama-3.1-8B-Base上进行的修正后12种子扩展实验，将其他方法置于与原始对比相同的分数尺度上。
tldr: 该论文提出了DataFlex-RL评估平台，在统一GRPO设置下系统比较13种RLVR数据策略，发现没有任何一种rollout选择、重新加权或自适应混合方法能显著优于简单的均匀采样。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DataFlex-RL, an evaluation platform that systematically compares 13 RLVR data policies under a unified GRPO setup, finding that none of the rollout-selection, reweighting, or adaptive mixture methods significantly outperforms simple uniform sampling.
